description: This file defines the GeoJSON class for handling GeoJSON objects in Leaflet, including methods for adding data, styling, and converting features to GeoJSON format. It also includes utility functions for GeoJSON data manipulation and integration with other Leaflet layers.

classes.name: GeoJSON
classes.description: A class extending FeatureGroup that represents a collection of GeoJSON features, with methods for adding data, styling, and converting features to GeoJSON.

methods.name: addData
methods.description: Adds a GeoJSON object or feature collection to the layer, creating corresponding Leaflet layers.

methods.name: resetStyle
methods.description: Resets the style of a given layer or all layers to their original GeoJSON style.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Applies a style function to all layers in the GeoJSON layer.
